title: The Invention and Early History of the CCD
lineage: First-person retrospective with apparatus and output photographs. It does not supply an exact date for the optical test.

passages.note: A participant describes the initial transfer experiment and the subsequent integrated eight-bit structure as distinct devices. Figure 8 shows the diffused input and output diodes and three-phase construction. Figure 9 reproduces a coarse optical image from the eight-bit CCD on an oscilloscope.
